name: Spam Filter
description: Flags spam and phishing messages and lets real mail through. Runs on 0G Compute's TeeML model (0gm-1.0-35b-a3b).

task.instructions: Classify each message as spam (unsolicited advertising, scams or phishing) or not_spam (a normal personal or work message).

labels.name: spam
labels.hint: winner, free, claim, prize, click, urgent offer, lottery

labels.name: not_spam
labels.hint: meeting, dinner, see you, thanks, attached, tomorrow
